messages:
Maria Chen: Heads up — quota dashboard shows 0 for recent routing-policy hits on canary, noticed during morning smoke :thinking:
Sam Patel: repro steps?
Maria Chen: Steps: 1) call /v1/generate with X-Route-Policy: weight=50; 2) check console > Routes > Policy -> last 1h; shows 0 tokens. Seen for python SDK only.
Maria Chen: quick snippet:
```
# using py sdk 1.4.0-canary
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key=...)
c.generate(prompt="hi", headers={"X-Route-Policy":"priority=high;quota=fast"})
```
Kevin Nguyen: That header rename from last proxy deploy (X-RW-RoutePolicy) went live? I thought we had aliasing in SDK.
Priya Rao: We merged a shim in ts/go but py shim got dropped during rebase — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/py-sdk/pull/241
Sam Patel: infra-bot shows proxy change at 1764199000 -> proxy v2.3 (route header canonicalization) :eyes:
infra-bot: deploy: proxy v2.3 rolled to canary (10%) at 1764199000, region us-west-2
Maria Chen: So prod canary calls are sending X-RW-RoutePolicy now, SDK still sending X-Route-Policy — console expects canonical header X-RW-RoutePolicy for telemetry attribution.
Kevin Nguyen: Quick mitigation: console should read both headers for attribution; or we push py hotfix to map old->new. Which is lower risk?
Priya Rao: Hotfix in py SDK is small — add header aliasing in request preparation. I'll open PR now. But console change is 2x larger (dash ingest pipeline).
Sam Patel: Can we patch console ingestion to accept both for a hot window? Quick fix by tomorrow then proper dashboard mapping later.
Maria Chen: Timeline: Priya opens PR now, can we cut a patch release today? we want canary backfilled telemetry.
Priya Rao: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/py-sdk/pull/242 — change is in client/request.py line ~88. Tests added. Assigning @Priya.
Kevin Nguyen: QA: we need to confirm backfill works — telemetry relies on routehash keys. If header name changes, ingestion might create new series. We need a transformation to normalize on ingest.
Sam Patel: I'll add a small normalization in the console pipeline to map X-Route-Policy -> X-RW-RoutePolicy for the past 24h of events. I can do a hot config switch.
Maria Chen: Steps for rollout:
- Priya: py SDK patch + release (patch semver)
- Kevin/Sam: console ingest normalization toggle and backfill
- Maria: monitor dashboard, confirm tokens appear and no double-counting
Owner tags: Priya (SDK), Sam (ingest), Kevin (monitor/QA)
Priya Rao: Cutting release branch now, will bump to 1.4.1 and publish wheel. ETA 2 hours.
Sam Patel: I'll schedule ingest toggle at 3pm UTC, backfill job to run in low traffic.
infra-bot: alert: canary proxy v2.3 at 10% shows 0.8% 5xx — within SLO
Maria Chen: Thanks all. After patch, let's add a test in e2e matrix: canonical header negotiation between proxy, sdk, console.
Kevin Nguyen: Also add telemetry regression alert for "route attribution drop > 30% for 1h" to catch future breaks.
Sam Patel: noted. I'll create ticket in #eng-sre and add to next sprint.
Maria Chen: :thumbsup:
